The difference between "delivered" and "in transit" on a tracking page typically refers to the delivery status at the time of the last update. If it was delivered, then the package has reached its destination and can be considered "delivered." However, if it is still listed as "in transit," it means that the package is currently being transported by the carrier and has not yet been received by the recipient. This could happen due to various reasons such as traffic delays, unexpected stops along the route, or other unforeseen circumstances. The actual delivery date will depend on these factors and the carrier's schedule.

A refund proposal means that a company has prepared a suggested amount of money to be refunded to the customer based on the specific reasons provided by the customer. It serves as a formal document outlining the proposed refund details before any actual transaction takes place. The purpose is to facilitate communication between the business and the customer regarding the terms of the refund, ensuring both parties are clear on expectations and procedures.
